up: Find all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1142978'. A compound is considered reported if it has a record in the compound_records table that links to that document. For each such compound, output its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). If a canonical SMILES is not available, include the compound anyway. Sort the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Return all matching compounds.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1142978' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
